sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 630119, captured 2026-10-12 (audit/state_park_fees/mt_sites_2026-10-12.json)

values.note: 33 sites in two loops, including 7 tent-only and one wheelchair-accessible site; the 12 electric sites are in Loop B.

sites.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/west-shore ('The campground has 33 campsites, including 7 tent-only sites and one wheelchair accessible site. The maximum length for RV/trailer units is 40 feet.') + ReserveAmerica site list (12 'Campsite Electric' in Loop B), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/west-shore-unit--flathead-lake-state-park/r/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=336&contractCode=MT&parkId=630119 (site B001, 'Type: Campsite Electric', 'Electricity Hookup: 50', 'Max Vehicle Length: 40') + https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/west-shore (Amenities 'RV Electrical Hookups'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Bear-resistant food lockers; boat launch (deep water, typically ice-free all winter).

facilities.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/west-shore (Amenities: 'Boat Launch', 'Camp Host', 'Electricity', 'RV Electrical Hookups', 'Toilets (Vault)', 'Water'; 'Bear resistant storage lockers are available') + ReserveAmerica park page (Services & Amenities 'Toilet, Pit/Vault', 'Water Drinking'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/west-shore ('Reserve a Campsite'; 'visit montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com or call 855-922-6768') + https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/west-shore-unit--flathead-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MT&parkId=630119 ('Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance.'), read 2026-10-22

note: West Shore unit of Flathead Lake State Park, 6 mi S of Lakeside on US-93. Two loops on wooded dolomite outcrops above Flathead Lake, with views of the Swan and Mission ranges. Tour Glacier rents kayaks, paddleboards and pedal boats at the park, June 15 - Labor Day. --Claude
summary: FWP + ReserveAmerica: confirmed 33 sites, 40-ft max, reservable on ReserveAmerica (90-day window, 1 day ahead; now verified for this park). Added 50-amp electric (12 Loop B sites), vault toilets, potable water, bear lockers/boat launch. Fees (FWP schedule, human) and season (manual) left; FWP says only 'Campsite fees range from $4-$34'. Note: site counts/lengths/reservable restatements dropped.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: ReserveAmerica tags all 12 Loop B electric sites (plus B013-B016 and the tent sites) 'Near Water', and site B001's page says 'Proximity to Water: Water View'; FWP says the park has 'an extensive shoreline that is excellent for picnicking and swimming'. The entry is 'not waterfront'.

Season note conflict (season is manual, not changed): the entry says 'Potable water May through September', but FWP's page now says potable water is 'Normally, available mid-March through November, weather permitting'.
Phone missing: FWP lists Flathead Lake Ranger Station 406-844-3044 (May - September) and 406-837-3041 (year-round); reservations 855-922-6768.
